data.completion_memo: W7 complete: the workflow editor and chat UI implement the full standard-agent frontend contract. (1) Typed node catalog: workbench/nodeCatalog.ts declares the 10 catalog node types with typed ports and declarative configuration fields; the palette and graph surface drive from it; NodeConfigurationForm renders per-node property forms (model-tier select from settings model_tiers, tool multi-select from enabled tools plus mcp:// free-entry via settings mcp_servers, maxTurns/instructions/predicate/tool parameter JSON); unknown node types keep the preserved raw-JSON editor. (2) Validator: connection port-type checks, condition true/false route labels, and Kahn cycle detection with nodesInCycles in workflow.ts. (3) Workflow library: WorkflowLibraryPort over the native workflow_library/create/duplicate/rename/delete/set_default commands with the WorkflowLibraryBar UI; workflow commits carry the workflowId with version-checked commits per document id. (4) Run integration: the composer lists saved workflows and defaults to the profile default, native workflow_snapshot(workflowId) validates the selection, and runStatus.ts projects per-node idle/running/completed/failed badges from committed node.* facts. (5) Timeline cards: plan (model_call node.completed), todo (tool.todo newest-wins), web results (tool.web_search/tool.web_fetch), collapsible subagent cards, and approval actions via activityProjection.ts over accumulated runtime facts. Simple Chat remains byte-compatible. COORDINATOR FIXES that closed the gate: (a) the credential-replacement recovery draft left consumers referencing the fresh credential without its metadata — reconcileCredentialReplacementDraft now carries the fresh credential from latestCanonical into the draft with dedup against the rebased canonical copy, and the call site passes both canonicals; (b) the SettingsScreen fixture's MCP STDIO command was a Unix absolute path invalid under the Windows launcher contract — the fixture now uses a bare PATH command on Windows; (c) a defensive test/setup localStorage polyfill for the jsdom environment. GATES: tsc --noEmit exit 0; vitest 18 files / 153 tests pass; vite build exit 0.
data.description: Complete the workflow editor and chat UI for the standard agent workflow. (1) Typed node catalog module feeding the palette with typed input/output ports per node type and per-node property forms (model tier select from configured tiers, tool multi-select from enabled tools, maxTurns, instructions, predicate fields, tool parameters) while unknown types keep the raw preserved-JSON editor; connection type validation, cycle detection, and route labels on condition edges in validateWorkflow. (2) Workflow library UI: list saved workflows from the native catalog, create from template (Simple Chat / Standard Agent / blank), rename, duplicate, delete, set default; version-checked commits per document id. (3) Run integration: Run starts a new Chat with the edited workflow selected; the editor shows projected per-node run status (idle/running/completed/failed) from committed node lifecycle events; the composer lists saved workflows and validates the selection natively. (4) Timeline cards: plan (model_call output), todo (live task list), web results (search/fetch), subagent (collapsible activity), approval (Approve/Reject actions bound to the approval command). Output: working editor + chat UI with Vitest coverage and the existing visual QA gates passing.
data.title: W7 — Complete workflow editor UI, workflow library, run status, composer selection, and timeline cards
